description: The OAuth scopes the Dibbla platform connector grants. Composable and reviewable: one scope per capability class, never one scope per tool.

scopes.name: platform:identity:read
scopes.summary: Read the granted user and organization. Returns only the granted organization; it can never be used to reach another.

scopes.name: platform:apps:read
scopes.summary: List and inspect applications in the granted organization.

scopes.name: platform:apps:write
scopes.summary: Create and update applications. Routine idempotent writes only.

scopes.name: platform:apps:restart
scopes.summary: Restart an application. Deliberately not implied by platform:apps:write.

scopes.name: platform:apps:delete
scopes.summary: Delete an application. Requires a bound confirmation in addition to the scope.

scopes.name: platform:deployments:read
scopes.summary: Read deployments and their status.

scopes.name: platform:deployment-proposals:write
scopes.summary: Create and inspect agent-authored deployment proposals. Approve/deny/apply is absent from the toolset: P-0034 four-eyes review stays in console and CLI.

scopes.name: platform:deployments:execute
scopes.summary: Start a deployment: upload a source archive through a principal-bound intent and deploy it. Never substitutes for platform:apps:write, and never carries the authority to approve a deployment that this organization's governance held for review.

scopes.name: platform:logs:read
scopes.summary: Read bounded application log windows.

scopes.name: platform:secrets:metadata:read
scopes.summary: Read secret names and metadata. There is no scope that reads a secret value, by construction.

scopes.name: platform:secrets:write
scopes.summary: Set and rotate secrets. Always produces an audit record.

scopes.name: platform:databases:read
scopes.summary: Read organization-owned database inventory and bounded status metadata. This scope is explicitly metadata-only and never grants row access.

scopes.name: platform:databases:rows:read
scopes.summary: Read bounded rows through the server-owned structured SELECT surface. Never accepts SQL; catalog allowlists, 100 rows, two seconds, 256 KiB, a SELECT-only role and shape-only query audit are mandatory.

scopes.name: platform:databases:write
scopes.summary: Provision managed databases as durable idempotent operations.

scopes.name: platform:databases:restore
scopes.summary: Restore a database from an organization-bound ready immutable file object. Destructive: an existing database of that name is overwritten. Requires a bound confirmation in addition to the scope, and is deliberately not implied by platform:databases:write.

scopes.name: platform:databases:delete
scopes.summary: Delete a managed database. Requires a bound confirmation.

scopes.name: platform:storage:read
scopes.summary: Read object-storage bucket inventory and metadata.

scopes.name: platform:storage:write
scopes.summary: Create and update buckets and bucket-scoped credentials.

scopes.name: platform:storage:rotate
scopes.summary: Rotate bucket credentials. Deliberately not implied by platform:storage:write.

scopes.name: platform:storage:delete
scopes.summary: Delete a bucket or its contents. Requires a bound confirmation.

scopes.name: platform:workflows:read
scopes.summary: Read workflows, revisions and run history.

scopes.name: platform:workflows:write
scopes.summary: Create and update workflow definitions.

scopes.name: platform:workflows:execute
scopes.summary: Execute a workflow at a pinned immutable revision. Deliberately not implied by platform:workflows:write.

scopes.name: platform:files:read
scopes.summary: Read file metadata and issue principal-bound download tickets. Never returns an internal presign.

scopes.name: platform:files:write
scopes.summary: Issue principal-bound upload tickets and register files.

scopes.name: platform:files:delete
scopes.summary: Delete a file. Requires a bound confirmation.

scopes.name: platform:operations:read
scopes.summary: Poll a durable operation by its principal-bound operation ID. The ID is data, never authentication.

scopes.name: platform:operations:cancel
scopes.summary: Cancel a durable operation. Deliberately not implied by any write scope.
